text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, while continuing to search 
for a way 
for Daring Tact to make a full comeback— 
I received a call from a certain 
physician.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Through a form of regenerative 
medicine, 
there is a chance we can restore the 
inflamed ligament 
to near-original condition.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—However, this treatment method 
has almost never been applied to this 
specific area.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Much less when it comes to returning to 
top-tier racing—there are simply no 
precedents.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
To fully restore her to the way she used 
to run... 
You must be prepared for immense 
difficulties.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Even so, with the inflammation still 
limited in scope, 
there is a chance surgery could cure it. 
...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Of course. Please do.
choice_data_list: By the way... why did you contact me?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I heard that her Trainer was desperately 
searching 
for a way to make a full recovery. So I 
thought 
I might be able to help. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...I'm a fan of hers. 
Ever since watching her win the Triple 
Tiara on TV, 
all this time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(I need to come to a decision soon. 
About what I... want to do from here on 
out.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Do I keep running, prepared for a decline 
in performance... 
or do I— 
Or...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's voices. 
They were so warm.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(If I return to the turf, gentle applause 
will be waiting. 
Even if my performance drops, 
I know everyone will still cheer me on...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(—They would surely praise me, 
saying I flew bravely on wounded wings.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I headed over to Daring Tact, 
she was standing outside, gazing absently 
at the sky. 
She still hasn't reached a decision, it 
seems.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I looked down at the envelope in my hands. 
It was a letter addressed to Daring Tact 
from the people back home in Hidaka.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Tact. We know this is a difficult 
time, 
and we didn't want to bother you with tons 
of phone calls, 
so we put everyone's feelings into a 
letter."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"When your Trainer got in touch with us, 
we were shocked. 
We were relieved to hear it wasn't too 
severe, 
but we're still worried about you."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Tact. 
You can come back home to Hidaka anytime, 
you know."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"You've shown us such a truly wonderful 
dream... 
You made us feel like we could keep giving 
our best, 
like we can keep going."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"As long as you stay healthy and safe, 
Daring Tact... 
there's nothing more we could ever ask 
for."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for all the dreams and hope 
you've given us."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
..."Thank you." 
Just how many times have they said that to 
me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's hearts are so full... 
as they praise the path I've walked.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So this is already... enough. 
I shouldn't dream for any more than 
this...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No! 
There's no way this is enough...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Not yet. I still... I still want to win! 
I can't let it end in a place like 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Because they believed in me! 
They believed that Daring Tact—is strong!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That Daring Tact can win! 
That Daring Tact... 
will show them even greater dreams...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I want to live up to that. ...No, I will 
live up to that! 
Because I'm—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm the Triple Tiara horsegirl 
who received everyone's love!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An unyielding fire ignited in her eyes. 
It was the first time she had ever shown 
such an explosive burst of pure passion.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
I want—a complete comeback.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Not a path where I run while favoring an 
injury, 
but one where I can keep running at my 
absolute best... 
Won't you find that path for me?!
choice_data_list: ...I had a feeling you'd say that.
...I had a feeling you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! 
Could it be, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Have you already 
found that path?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—If I undergo this surgery, 
will the affected area heal?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Will I be able to run the way I want to... 
the way Daring Tact should run?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Provided the surgery is a success, 
and you regain your performance, of 
course—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it! 
Please perform the surgery!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
That being said, managing the inflammation 
properly 
and learning to live with it carries far 
less risk 
as a general rule.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I would even consider that the best option 
if you want to keep running. 
Even so, are you willing to bet on the 
possibility of surgery?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I am.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Continuing to run at my very best is what 
I desire. 
If there is even the slightest chance of 
walking that path, 
I'll bet everything on it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You believe it's a challenge worth taking 
too, 
don't you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Then my answer will not change! 
—Please proceed with the surgery!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Daring Tact chose— 
as a Triple Tiara horsegirl, 
"the path to victory."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, the hard part starts from 
here... 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To fully restore her former running form, 
she'll have to push through daily rehab 
and checkups... 
working all the way back from negative to 
zero.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, seeking performance that 
surpasses her past self 
won't happen overnight... The immense toll 
it will take on her 
isn't hard to imagine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, I have a request. 
May I set a target race?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If I have a goal in mind, 
I feel like I can give rehab my all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before her injury was discovered, the 
candidate was 
the Victoria Mile. However— 
it's coming up far too soon.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, it's alright. 
Please tell me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: The Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. 
I was thinking the exact same thing.
choice_data_list: Can we really make it in time, though...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The doctor told me that if I work super 
hard, 
there is a chance I could return in time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I don't intend to overdo it 
recklessly. 
It's just—a demanding challenge is 
actually what I want.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I can do it. 
...What do you think?
choice_data_list: ...Alright, let's set it as our goal!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! 
I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This hospital is so big... 
I need to memorize where the rehab room is 
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She loves nature, so spending long hours 
cooped up in a cramped room would be tough 
on her. 
In that case, somewhere she could go 
outdoors—
choice_data_list:
(Come to think of it, doesn't the URA 
have...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Trainer?
choice_data_list: Tact, do you like hot springs?

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff
text_block_list.text:
We've been waiting for you, Daring Tact! 
Welcome to the 
Umamusume Rehabilitation Center!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Wow...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Located in Iwaki, Fukushima Prefecture, 
this is, 
as the name implies, a rehab facility for 
horsegirls. 
However, what sets it apart from ordinary 
facilities is—

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, we have a hot spring bath 
attached, 
and locals affectionately call it 
the "Hot Springs for Horsegirls"!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff
text_block_list.text:
Beyond standard rehabilitation equipment, 
you can walk 
in a warm-water pool or refresh yourself 
in the hot springs— 
that's our specialty♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've already received special permission 
from Tracen Academy 
for her to stay at this facility for a 
while.
choice_data_list: Let's focus on your rehab here!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
Thank you very much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for having me. 
I look forward to working with you!
